scoring: Per area: round(100 * verified offline weight / applicable weight); runtime controls and exceptions earn zero. preparation_score includes configured runtime controls. Overall uses area_weights. No runtime evidence is imported.

requirements.threshold: Every critical path declares a positive p95_ms budget, error_rate in [0,1), window and owner.
remediation: Copy and adapt new/templates/slo.yaml.tpl into the preparation directory.
Set critical paths, p95_ms, error_rate, measurement window and owner.
Run helix perf scan in the project; retain evidence and owner review.

requirements.threshold: All project k6 thresholds pass at the declared load; configuration alone earns no verified points.

Run helix perf scan in the project; retain evidence and owner review.

requirements.threshold: Assets, trust boundaries, abuse cases and applicable ASVS version/IDs are reviewed with named owners.
